description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'TestUtil' with static methods supporting testing activities within the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for assertions, property handling, table data printing, global property management, and date manipulation used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for testing activities such as assertions, property handling, database table printing, global property management, and date creation.

methods.name: assertCollectionContentsEquals
methods.description: Checks if two collections contain the same objects, ignoring order. Throws AssertionError if they differ.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Mimics org.openmrs.web.Listener.getRuntimeProperties(), loading properties from environment variables, application data directory, or current directory based on the webappName.

methods.name: printAssignableToSingleString
methods.description: Converts a multiline string into a single-line string with escaped newlines and quotes, suitable for assignment to a single String variable.

methods.name: printStringBuilderOutput
methods.description: Formats a multiline string into Java code lines that append each line to a StringBuilder with newlines.

methods.name: printOutTableContents
methods.description: Prints contents of specified database table(s) in XML format to stdout for debugging.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with the specified name and value.

methods.name: containsId
methods.description: Checks if a collection of BaseOpenmrsObject contains an object with a specific id.

methods.name: waitForClockTick
methods.description: Pauses execution until system clock moves to the next second.

methods.name: createDateTime
methods.description: Creates a Date object by parsing a string in various datetime formats.
